task.title: Implement Pi fresh-worker spawn bridge
task.summary: Let runtime request fresh Pi worker or gate sessions through supported Pi package/SDK primitives with exact platform/content blockers and dirty-content handoff policy.

goal.outcome: Runtime can request linked fresh Pi worker/gate sessions or return exact platform blockers without pretending ctx.newSession is parallel spawning.
acceptance: Runtime exposes a fresh-worker request/handoff contract with role, task/build refs, trace refs, gate refs, Git refs, and content evidence requirements.
Pi bridge uses supported subprocess/RPC/SDK worker primitives where available and records platform-limited blockers when unavailable.
Dirty pre-commit implementation gate checks require exact working_tree_digest plus patch/worktree handoff evidence; promotion gates require immutable content evidence.
Daemon/agency stop reasons include exact platform/content/remediation diagnostics for unavailable spawn or unsafe dirty transfer.
Graph/readiness views consume exact trace/gate/Git/artifact refs for daemon-safe scheduling.
Automation-readiness and agency scheduling cite exact trace/gate/git blockers from graph state.
Legacy build/gate artifacts remain readable through compatibility normalization; no broad historical artifact migration is required.
Runtime tests prove fresh-worker request, blocker, dirty handoff, and readiness behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement full lifecycle trace schema/catalog in this task.
Do not remove deprecated skill folders in this task.
Do not claim ctx.newSession spawns parallel sessions.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
